shots: FBLA people will bring a laminated|résumé to a sleepover,
answer the group chat|with "per my last email,"
then ask, how'd you know|I went to nationals?
You've traded so many pins|your blazer weighs eleven pounds,
you practiced your speech|on a drive-thru speaker,
and you call your mom|a valued stakeholder.
Seems cool being|a normal FBLA member.
I wish I could be one,
but I can't because|I went to nationals.
You met me at a very|nationals time in my life.
